parameters.name: InstanceClass
parameters.description:
The instance specification for two-way synchronization. Valid values: **large**, **medium**, **micro**, and **small**.
> For more information about instance specifications, see [Specifications of data synchronization instances](~~26605~~).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).
